gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Retrieval practice always improves immediate recall.
gapQuestions.rationale: Restudy advantage at five minutes in both primary experiments contradicts universal timing.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Higher prose recall means the whole Domain Knowledge profile increased.
gapQuestions.rationale: Recall probability under one cue is not accurate domain coverage plus organization.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Future-learning prediction is current Memory Confidence.
gapQuestions.rationale: Predicting next week's recall and judging current recollection accuracy are different estimands.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Confirming identification feedback increases current Memory Confidence.
gapQuestions.rationale: Current versus retrospective ratings, correct/incorrect IDs and latency must be disaggregated before signing exact effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: High memory confidence proves accuracy.
gapQuestions.rationale: Initial pristine-lineup association is conditional; feedback can inflate certainty without improving identification.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Outcome density increases causal-belief strength.
gapQuestions.rationale: Simulated contingencies and rating-format effects are not exact canonical exposure Driver; no invented entity or causal coefficient.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Causal-belief score is a PSYWERX edge weight.
gapQuestions.rationale: A person's confidence in a proposition is not objective causal magnitude or executable science.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Concept mapping improves Mental Model Coherence.
gapQuestions.rationale: Learning scores do not directly verify internal connectedness/noncontradiction.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A concept-map/test-score gain increases all Domain Knowledge dimensions.
gapQuestions.rationale: Reuse Layer multidimensional feature-scope escalation; no normalized complete profile or validation of whole-construct change.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A coherent internal model is necessarily true.
gapQuestions.rationale: Internal consistency can organize false premises.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A concept-map connection creates a PSYWERX Relationship or social tie.
gapQuestions.rationale: Representation, scientific proposition and interpersonal configuration are distinct.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Environmental context reinstatement changes memory accessibility.
gapQuestions.rationale: Cue competition, encoding context and internal reinstatement need exact operation/endpoint mapping; no universal place effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Stress lowers memory accessibility.
gapQuestions.rationale: Direction differs by encoding/consolidation/retrieval timing and context; physiological stress not identical to PSY-054 appraisal.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Stress→cortisol→memory is an identified pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: Cortisol response magnitude did not relate to memory effect in meta-analysis; pathway identification absent.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Expected digital access changes memory accessibility.
gapQuestions.rationale: Content versus storage-location tests differ; expectation, actual availability and future cue must align to exact endpoint.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Failed computer-word priming replication disproves every Google-memory experiment.
gapQuestions.rationale: Original priming and expected-storage experiments have different manipulations/outcomes.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Technology uniformly destroys enduring memory capacity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Task-specific costs and benefits do not establish global lasting trait change.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Confederate misinformation changes reported memory.
gapQuestions.rationale: Intrusions show suggestibility under specified scenes; exact accuracy/accessibility/confidence target not yet resolved.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A socially introduced false memory increases accurate knowledge.
gapQuestions.rationale: Accessibility of misinformation is not accurate Domain Knowledge.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cultural background relates to memory specificity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Country-group comparison is not randomized culture, and recognition precision/response bias not one Family construct.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Institutional testing policy improves all students' knowledge.
gapQuestions.rationale: A controlled recall operation differs from grading, access, stakes and instruction; no policy effect inferred.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Prior knowledge modifies REL-PSY-033 congruence→counterarguing.
gapQuestions.rationale: No exact PSY-065 measurement × governed-edge interaction extracted; broad learner moderation not sufficient.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Repetition→familiarity→belief is a transmitted pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: Existing separate edges and F01 total operation effect do not identify mediated transmitted effect; no double contribution.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Domain Knowledge and Memory Accessibility overlap.
gapQuestions.rationale: Accessible false or disorganized content differs from accurate organized knowledge; partial measurement overlap not identity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Perceived congruence equals factual veracity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Felt agreement can be wrong; source strength and target accuracy mismatch remain separate.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Retrieval practice precedes better later recall as a formal temporal edge.
gapQuestions.rationale: An operation/outcome study does not supply an ontology-entity sequence distinct from scoped EffectAssertion; no redundant temporal record.
